\section[\texorpdfstring{\ru{расписание} (raspisániye)}{расписание (raspisániye)}]{\ru{расписание} (raspisániye) — a timetable}

\label{lesson:RU-C139-raspisaniye}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Russian for to plan, then the Russian for to hope.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ru{расписание}}
\textbf{\ru{расписание}} (\emph{raspisániye}) — \textquotedblleft{}a timetable\textquotedblright{}.

\emph{Read it:} the board

The board says \textbf{\ru{Автобус}: 8:00.} The bus leaves at eight, so be there before eight.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{raspisániye}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{raspisániye}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Russian for to plan, then the Russian for to hope, then say \emph{raspisániye} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ru{расписание} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A timetable\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ru{вход} (vkhod)}{вход (vkhod)}]{\ru{вход} (vkhod) — an entrance}

\label{lesson:RU-C139-vkhod}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Russian for a timetable, then the Russian for an advert.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ru{вход}}
\textbf{\ru{вход}} (\emph{vkhod}) — \textquotedblleft{}an entrance\textquotedblright{}.

\emph{Read it:} the sign over a door

The sign over a door says \textbf{\ru{ВХОД}}: you go in here. \textbf{\ru{Вход} \ru{свободный}} means entry is free.

\section[(dialogue)]{Saying no and looking back — a first pass}

\label{lesson:RU-R139-first-pass-saying-no-and-looking-back}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an exit and a receipt.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item nobody, nothing, nowhere, (to) nowhere, what for
  \item recently, long ago; for a long time, before, last, to happen
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Nobody? (\textbf{\ru{никто}}.) Nothing? (\textbf{\ru{ничего}}.) Nowhere? (\textbf{\ru{нигде}}.) (to) nowhere? (\textbf{\ru{никуда}}.) What for? (\textbf{\ru{зачем}}.) Recently? (\textbf{\ru{недавно}}.) Long ago; for a long time? (\textbf{\ru{давно}}.) Before? (\textbf{\ru{раньше}}.) Last? (\textbf{\ru{прошлый}}.) To happen? (\textbf{\ru{случиться}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Looking ahead and reading signs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:RU-R139-second-pass-looking-ahead-and-reading-signs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for future and in.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item future, in, a plan, to plan, to hope
  \item a timetable, an advert, an entrance, an exit, a receipt
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Future? (\textbf{\ru{будущий}}.) In? (\textbf{\ru{через}}.) A plan? (\textbf{\ru{план}}.) To plan? (\textbf{\ru{планировать}}.) To hope? (\textbf{\ru{надеяться}}.) A timetable? (\textbf{\ru{расписание}}.) An advert? (\textbf{\ru{реклама}}.) An entrance? (\textbf{\ru{вход}}.) An exit? (\textbf{\ru{выход}}.) A receipt? (\textbf{\ru{чек}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
